title: Set up the document types you use
description: Add the kinds of document your business handles from the ready-made catalogue (Purchase Invoice, Credit Note, Statement and more), each arriving complete with its fields and likely labels, and mention building a custom type by hand. Settings -> Document Types.

steps.narration: ScanFinder needs to know which kinds of document you deal with — invoices, statements, delivery notes and the rest. Let's add them from the ready-made catalogue.
steps.caption: Set up your document types

steps.narration: Open Settings from the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Open Settings

steps.narration: Go to the Document Types tab.
steps.caption: 2. Document Types tab

steps.narration: Three come built in — Invoice, Sales Order and Purchase Order. Most businesses want a few more than that.
steps.caption: Invoice, Sales Order, Purchase Order

steps.narration: Click Add from catalogue to see the ready-made types.
steps.caption: 3. Add from catalogue

steps.narration: Each one arrives complete with its fields and the labels it's likely to see on the page, so reading works well before you teach anything.
steps.caption: Each comes with its fields ready

steps.narration: Tick the types your business uses —
steps.caption: 4. Tick the ones you use

steps.narration: — a purchase invoice, a credit note, whatever fits.
steps.caption: Tick a few

steps.narration: Then click Add selected, and they're all created in one go.
steps.caption: 5. Add selected

steps.narration: They're in your list straight away, each one ready to file and to learn from as documents come in.
steps.caption: Added and ready to use

steps.narration: And if you have something unusual, New type lets you build one by hand with its own fields.
steps.caption: Something unusual? New type

steps.narration: That's your document types set up. Next: deciding where they get filed.
steps.caption: Next: folders & filenames
